extra.reason: 1.0 product/domain contract documented and roadmap aligned
Cross-platform CPack/release automation, install layout, Windows portable install/uninstall, version identity, checksums and installed-tool smoke implemented and locally qualified
VS Code/Cursor extension packages production LSP, run/check/fmt/debug commands and semantic emoji palette; npm validation and VSIX packaging green

Named records, keyed values, and recoverable result values are implemented as ordinary verifier-visible Emojineer semantics. Module/package linking preserves pure intrinsics; EMJBC v10 compatibility/fencing, LSP/editor exposure, ABI rejection behavior, Debug/Release 27/27, and ASan/UBSan qualification are green.

Explicit run/exec argv plus default-deny capability-gated filesystem write/directory and bounded richer HTTPS request facilities are implemented. Preflight denial proves zero filesystem effects; sandbox/deterministic policy, linked-module authority, utility CLI/runtime tests, Debug/Release 27/27, and ASan/UBSan qualification are green.

Bounded first-class bytes plus explicit UTF-8, hex, and Base64 codecs are implemented with malformed UTF-8, non-canonical Base64, byte-vs-grapheme boundary, round-trip, byte indexing/update, module-linking, EMJBC v10, Debug/Release 27/27, and ASan/UBSan coverage green. Emoji Stories remain out of scope.
